Wow! This is the type of game that I was looking for before I got the Vive. I will now use this as my offical immersion demo. I liked everrything about it. Very short of course (Demo) but, lets you know where the vive can take you. Thanks Michael Conelly! Keep up the great work! There is a book out that he wrote, but im not going to read it because SPOLIERS. Big ups Mr. Conelly! This is a nice little demo that makes me very excited for the full series. You spend about 10 minutes exploring a dark pathway followed by some sinister catacombs. Along the way you are followed by the creepy bald fellow who you periodically converse with and you have a torch that you use to light the way. The environment is very immersive, I just hope they improve the flame effect since it looks a bit flat compared to everything else.

It's not a big demo so it doesn't take long to download and play, I suggest everyone who is interested in story based games to at least check it out. The graphics of the enviroment needs an overhaul in some places, but the locations are interesting . The demo is really short, but it does give you a feel for the game, and it looks to be amasing. The place you arrive at before the demo ended left me in awe as I gazed into the darkness of one of the most interesting and imposing lcoations I've seen in VR.

Played with Rift without any issues.
